title: Opening of new Quebec legislature session postponed to Dec. 1
detail: The opening of the new session of the National Assembly, which includes the throne speech, was pushed back to Dec. 1 (reported Nov. 4). The delay follows a dispute over whether Lt.-Gov. Manon Jeannotte may take part; the PQ government has said it wants to keep her out and is seeking legal advice, while Conservative leader Éric Duhaime proposed she deliver her address from her office. The opposition has pressed for an earlier date.

media.caption: Opening of new session at Quebec legislature postponed to Dec. 1
